wbs.description: Add failing coverage for both real pull-request shapes plus rebase, ordinary merge, fast-forward, tree mismatch, reverted descendant, and incomplete inventory negatives, with mergeMethod deliberately unset so the observation short-circuit cannot mask the new path
Implement the conjunctive multi-source squash predicate and wire it into the rewritten-one-parent branch beside the existing single-source proof
Run focused and bounded lane verification, then deliver through the governed provider flow so the delivery intent exists before the provider action

risks: A new test passing through the existing mergeMethodObservation short-circuit instead of the new proof
Weakening or disturbing the existing single-source external-squash proof
Treating tree equality as sufficient when a rebase produces the same final tree
Threading async ancestry into the pure synchronous classifyMergeMethod instead of keeping the proof separate
